headline: OpenAI teases Codex device launch on July 15th
summary: OpenAI partners with Work Louder for Codex-focused device
details: OpenAI is releasing a device related to its AI-powered coding tool, Codex, on July 15th. The device is built in collaboration with Work Louder, a company that sells mechanical keyboards and macro pads.
The teaser video shows a square-shaped device with several buttons, alongside the caption, 'Your favorite Codex shortcuts are getting an upgrade.'
The silhouette of the device looks similar to Work Louder's Creator Micro 2, a macro pad with 13 mechanical switches, a joystick, and a touch sensor.

headline_marked: OCI Database [[Auto Backup Window]] has 12 UTC time slots
headline: OCI Database Auto Backup Window has 12 UTC time slots
summary: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Database service offers 12 two-hour UTC time windows for automatic backups.
details: The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Database service provides an optional auto_backup_window option in its API during database creation. This feature allows users to choose a time window for automatic backups.
There are 12 two-hour UTC time windows available for initiating automatic backups. For example, selecting SLOT_TWO will start the backup job between 2:00 AM (inclusive) and 4:00 AM (exclusive).
If no option is selected, a start time between 12:00 AM to 7:00 AM in the region of the database is automatically chosen.
caption:
Can you schedule your OCI database backups for a specific time?

The Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Database service provides an optional auto_backup_window option in its API during database creation. This feature allows users to choose a time window for automatic backups.

There are 12 two-hour UTC time windows available for initiating automatic backups. For example, selecting SLOT_TWO will start the backup job between 2:00 AM (inclusive) and 4:00 AM (exclusive).

If no option is selected, a start time between 12:00 AM to 7:00 AM in the region of the database is automatically chosen.
